notes.title: New release date! Keep an eye on Steam Next Fest 🎮
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello, this is Akaizer![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I've decided to make a difficult but important decision about the game's release: I'm postponing the date to align it with [b]Steam Next Fest![/b][/p][p]It wasn't an easy choice, but it's a strategic one. The game is 75% ready to be played, which is precisely why I want it to get the attention it deserves. At the moment, with the release planned for this month, the game had little visibility on the store. Taking part in Next Fest will give me a great opportunity to show my work to more people.[/p][p][/p][p]I really appreciate your support and patience. This is all to ensure that the game gets off to the best possible start 💜[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you at Steam Next Fest 2025 ~[/p][p][/p][p]*New dragons are being made :D[/p]
